title: Table2Image: Lightweight Tabular Learning with Generated Proxy Representations and Reliability Diagnostics
abstract: arXiv:2412.06265v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Deep tabular models should ideally balance predictive performance, parameter efficiency, and robustness to imperfect learning signals---properties that are rarely considered jointly. We present Table2Image, a lightweight tabular learning model built around a learned generation pathway that maps tabular inputs into intermediate, structured proxy representations. We additionally examine a variant with variance inflation factor (VIF)-informed initialization, which downweights highly collinear features at the start of training. Across datasets from OpenML-CC18 and TabZilla, Table2Image achieves competitive clean predictive performance while remaining compact relative to several large-scale neural baselines. translated_title: Table2Image：基于生成代理表示与可靠性诊断的轻量级表格学习
translated_abstract: 深度表格模型理想情况下应平衡预测性能、参数效率和对不完美学习信号的鲁棒性——这些属性很少被联合考虑。我们提出了Table2Image，一种轻量级表格学习模型，其核心是一个学习生成通路，将表格输入映射为中间的结构化代理表示。我们还研究了一个变体，采用方差膨胀因子（VIF）信息初始化的方法，在训练开始时降低高度共线性特征的权重。在OpenML-CC18和TabZilla数据集上，Table2Image在保持竞争力的干净预测性能的同时，相对于多个大规模神经基线模型更加紧凑。我们进一步引入了一个统一的、严重程度受控的评估协议，涵盖三种不完美学习条件——无关输入、损坏监督和不稳定捷径关联——该协议结合了基于性能的鲁棒性度量。
tldr: Table2Image通过生成代理表示和VIF初始化，在轻量级模型下实现竞争性预测性能，并提出了一个统一的不完美学习条件评估协议来诊断可靠性。
en_tdlr: Table2Image achieves competitive predictive performance with a lightweight model via generated proxy representations and VIF-informed initialization, while introducing a unified evaluation protocol for reliability diagnostics under imperfect learning conditions.
